sentences.text: Asteroid Day -LRB- also known as International Asteroid Day -RRB- is an annual global event that aims to raise awareness about asteroids and what can be done to protect the Earth , its families , communities , and future generations .	asteroids	asteroids	Earth	Earth

Asteroid Day is held on the anniversary of the June 30 , 1908 Siberian Tunguska event , the most harmful known asteroid-related event on Earth in recent history .	Earth	Earth	Tunguska event	Tunguska event
The United Nations has proclaimed that Asteroid Day will be observed globally on June 30 every year in its resolution .	United Nations	United Nations

It was co-founded by filmmaker Grigorij Richters , B612 Foundation COO Danica Remy , Apollo 9 astronaut Rusty Schweickart and Brian May , Queen guitarist and astrophysicist .	Grigorij Richters	Grigorij Richters	B612 Foundation	B612 Foundation	Apollo 9	Apollo 9	Rusty Schweickart	Rusty Schweickart	Brian May	Brian May	Queen	Queen (band)

Over 200 astronauts , scientists , technologists and artists , including Richard Dawkins , Bill Nye , Peter Gabriel , Jim Lovell , Apollo 11 Astronaut Michael Collins , Alexei Leonov , Bill Anders , Kip Thorne , Lord Martin Rees , Chris Hadfield , Rusty Schweickart and Brian Cox co-signed the Asteroid Day Declaration .	Rusty Schweickart	Rusty Schweickart	Richard Dawkins	Richard Dawkins	Bill Nye	Bill Nye	Peter Gabriel	Peter Gabriel	Jim Lovell	Jim Lovell	Alexei Leonov	Alexei Leonov	Bill Anders	Bill Anders	Kip Thorne	Kip Thorne	Martin Rees	Martin Rees	Chris Hadfield	Chris Hadfield	Brian Cox	Brian Cox (physicist)
Asteroid Day was officially launched on December 3 , 2014 .
